column1: # One program per line: name<TAB>absolute program<TAB>arguments (tab-separated).
# Each runs natively twice and on every backend, under the pass-through recorder.
# python3 runs with a fixed hash seed: its startup order otherwise varies between runs.
# It also runs with bytecode writing disabled: with a cold bytecode cache the
# first run writes .pyc files (openat=ENOENT, then a write) and the second reads
# them back (openat=3), so the two native runs differ run-to-run. A per-run
# PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX would need comparator-supplied per-run state, which the
# static corpus cannot express; disabling the write makes both runs take the
# same no-cache path. A fixed, never-created PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX alongside it
# also stops either run from reading a shared __pycache__ another process
